compiled_state.title: As an orchestrator, I dispatch the opus arbiter on RESUSTAIN_OF defended findings and validate structured severity_rebuttal
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Create plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-arbiter.md with trinary output schema (SUSTAIN_AT_SEVERITY | ACCEPT_DEFENSE | DOWNGRADE_TO_<severity>) and required severity_rebuttal subfields (reviewer_claimed_severity verbatim, reviewer_severity_evidence verbatim, named_rebuttal cited-lines-backed). Orchestrator dispatches arbiter when reviewer relation is RESUSTAIN_OF and prior defense exists. Schema validator rejects DOWNGRADE_TO whose named_rebuttal lacks a cited line not present in reviewer_severity_evidence; rejected DOWNGRADE_TO is reclassified as ACCEPT_DEFENSE. Decisions recorded as defense records with arbiter:true.
**Why**: SC4 structured terminator for sustained disagreement. Replaces the MAX_ATTEMPTS->user-escalation backstop with a binding ruling.
**Scope**:
  IN:
  - code-reviewer-arbiter.md created with trinary output, anti-compromise instruction, severity_rebuttal schema
  - Orchestrator dispatch logic for RESUSTAIN_OF + prior defense triggers single arbiter call
  - Two-layer rejection: structural cited-line check primary; token-overlap heuristic secondary
  - Arbiter rulings written as defense records with cited_lines_fingerprint snapshot
  - Durable binding scoped to fingerprint: subsequent cycles cannot re-raise this ID at this fingerprint
  OUT:
  - Reviewer Call 1 / Call 2 (S8)
  - Proximity verification (S9)
  - DefenseStore (S6)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, when a reviewer raises RESUSTAIN_OF on a previously defended finding, the opus arbiter is dispatched and its trinary ruling is recorded as a defense record bound to the cited_lines_fingerprint
  ← Satisfies: "Opus arbiter with trinary authority, structured severity_rebuttal, and durable fingerprint binding"
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Testing] Generic-template patterns for token-overlap heuristic refined post-launch via arbiter telemetry
- [Reliability] Whitespace-only reformat preserves fingerprint binding; semantic edits release it

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
